areas.t: Monday, November 2 and Tuesday, November 3: Mixing will decrease as an upper-level ridge of high pressure moves across Ohio. Furthermore, southerly to south-southwesterly surface winds throughout much of the period will carry regional pollutants into the Mahoning Valley, keeping AQI levels low-Moder

Current Conditions: High pressure is bringing a mixture of clouds and sunshine today. The air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is mostly good, and the air from the surface through the upper levels of the atmosphere remains clean with no smoke suspended aloft from distant wildfires. *** Tu
